svg.title: Retained uncapped frontier comparison: dose, floor observation, 3D distance and remaining frontiers

g.text: Reactor · seeds 1 / 0 / 0 · ideal pose · no dose/time cap · both endpoints incomplete
Curves end at each robot’s actual stop. Lower endpoint dose is not an equal-duration comparison.
Finished requires zero frontiers on three fresh scans. The observed-floor percentage never ends a mission.
